title: Seasonal plate hierarchy
summary: An original geometric food fixture with one plate, three bounded food forms and explicit steam cues, created without ingredient photography or third-party media.

record.title: Seasonal plate hierarchy prompt
record.purpose: Provide a bounded food worked example with observable plate, ingredient grouping and steam hierarchy.
record.sourceText: A fictional warm seasonal plate composed from simple color forms and three steam paths.

prompt.positive: One oval plate containing three clearly separated fictional food forms, a green base accent and three rising steam paths, warm restrained palette, simple overhead-oblique presentation.
